name: wiki_page
description: Native content type derived from the real Wiki app doctype (integrations/frappe-bench/apps/wiki/wiki/wiki/doctype/wiki_page/wiki_page.json). A community charter is a wiki_page in the root namespace whose route is charters/<community>/<slug>, written by that community's active members; community names the body, edited_by the member who saved this revision, and revision_note what they changed.
